Looking for Historical Sources?

Researching someone persecuted under the Nazi regime? If you are having trouble locating historical records, photographs, documents, or other source materials, Bry may be able to help. Through his research for Pink Triangle Portraits, he has gathered a growing collection of references and resources. While he cannot guarantee he will have the information you are looking for, he is happy to share relevant sources or point you toward other places to search.
